name: Counter
description: The template's example hook. Counts three events per pool: beforeSwap, afterSwap and beforeAddLiquidity. Each callback adds one to its own counter and returns a zero delta and no fee override. It holds no funds, changes no price or fee, and has no owner and no upgrade path.

reasons: No dynamic fee: beforeSwap returns a fee override of 0, and the hook never calls updateDynamicLPFee.
Swaps and deposits work with empty hookData; the hook never reads it.
The 0x91 address-prefix rule applies to a deployed address. This hook is not deployed.

pool.binding: None. Any pool may name this hook; each PoolId gets its own three counters.
pool.fee: Any. The hook does not read or set the fee.

deltas.settledBy: Nobody. Without the beforeSwapReturnDelta bit the PoolManager does not read the delta, and a fee override is honoured only on a dynamic-fee pool.
Nobody. Without the afterSwapReturnDelta bit the PoolManager does not read the value.

securityAssumptions: Assumes the v4 `PoolManager` is the only caller of the three callbacks (enforced by the `onlyPoolManager` modifier inherited from `BaseHook`).
doesNotGuarantee: Does not count removals of liquidity, donations or pool initialisation: the address carries no flag for them.
Does not say what a counted swap or deposit achieved: who acted, in which direction, for how much, or at what price.
Does not count a swap the pool rejects. beforeSwap runs before the pool validates the swap, but its increment reverts with the call.
Does not restrict which pools use it. Anyone can initialise a pool that names this hook.

invariants.statement: The hook's address carries exactly the permissions it declares: beforeAddLiquidity, beforeSwap and afterSwap, mask 0x8C0.
The constructor rejects an address that carries two of the three bits.
After any 1 to 5 completed swaps, alternating direction, of 1 wei to 1e17 each, beforeSwapCount and afterSwapCount both equal the number of swaps.
Adding liquidity raises beforeAddLiquidityCount by one; removing liquidity changes no counter.
A swap the pool rejects after beforeSwap ran leaves every counter unchanged.
No caller other than the PoolManager can run a callback or move a counter.
